The report opens on virustotal.com. Close it to get back to where you were.
You can also share a link to Check on VirusTotal from any app\'s Share menu.
Including the domain in an email address

Ninpo Scout has no account, no ads and no tracking, and it can\'t connect to the internet itself. Your browser opens VirusTotal with only the link, domain, IP address or hash, never the rest of the text you selected.
VirusTotal scans what you check and shares it with the security community, so don\'t check private links, like password reset or shared document links.
